handoff_note: Goal run finished 2026-10-31. Run mode: quiet (chosen by the person in Allomos). All 13 tasks done: v0.1 search and ticker details, v0.2 accounts and private lists, v0.3 live at https://ticker.allomos.com. Every acceptance criterion of the spec was checked on the live site (A01-toy025 Evidence). Left for the person: try the app (steps), sign in with their own address, and review the AI decisions (alm human). Not covered by the free data plan: exchanges outside the US, and indexes such as the S&P 500 (paid Twelve Data plans).
human_check_steps:
Try the whole app at https://ticker.allomos.com (on a computer and on a phone):

1. Search by name or ticker: apple, NVDA, vanguard, bitcoin, yen. Listings the free data does
   not cover (for example Tokyo stocks such as Toyota, 7203) are greyed and marked.
2. Open a ticker: latest price and its time, the day's change, a chart with 1D, 5D, 1M, 6M,
   YTD, 1Y, 5Y and MAX, and key figures (open, previous close, day range, 52-week range, volume).
3. Sign in with your email address: a link arrives from no-reply@ticker.allomos.com; open it and
   click Sign in.
4. Make several lists, rename and delete them; add tickers from search results and ticker pages
   ("☆ Add to list", one tick per list); remove them with ×.
5. Your lists show each ticker's price and day change. Sign in on another device: same lists.
   Another account sees none of them.
Prices are delayed and refresh every few minutes; the free data plan allows 8 requests a minute,
so a long new list fills in over a minute or two.
